beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Milan joins inherited house authority to contemporary systems of staging, craft, platform distribution, wholesale and traceability. This chapter follows circulation: A public stream can widen technical access while ranking systems, language, bandwidth and platform ownership continue to govern attention.
beats.onScreen: Then: CNMI says its 2020 Digital Fashion Hub was designed and developed with Accenture, supported by Microsoft technology, with requirements work by PwC.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: CNMI says its 2020 Digital Fashion Hub was designed and developed with Accenture, supported by Microsoft technology, with requirements work by PwC. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The 2020 platform ran continuously across time zones and supported scheduled brand storytelling, while CNMI also published a multibrand virtual-showroom video.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: A permanent future supplier stack or successor platform is not inferred from the 2020 announcement.
